title: Issue with Plugin to Create Standard Set of Audio Busses (and set the send-to)
body: ### Tested versions Godot v4.6.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9571) - Intel(R) Core(TM) 7 240H (16 threads) - 15.70 GiB memory ### System information Godot v4.6.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9571) - Intel(R) Core(TM) 7 240H (16 threads) - 15.70 GiB memory ### Issue description I've created a plug-in to automate creating audiobusses, it loops through an array, yet it fails to name the last bus in the array. It also will fail to set the Send-To for the audio bus, but I'm not worried about that as much as the weirdness with the last one failing to name. ```gdscript @tool extends EditorPlugin func _enter_tree() -> void: add_tool_menu_item("Create Audio Bus Set", _on_tool_menu_clicked) pass func _exit_tree() -> void: remove_tool_menu_item("Create Audio Bus Set") pass var bus_names = ["SFX", "SFX_TYPE", "MUSIC", "MUSIC_MIX", "VOICE", "ENVIRONMENT"] var sub_sfx = ["SFX_TYPE"] var sub_music = ["MUSIC_MIX"] func _on_tool_menu_clicked(): print("Tool menu item clicked!") for name in bus_names: create_bus(name) print("creating audio bus ", name) for name in sub_sfx: var this_bus = AudioServer.get_bus_index(name) AudioServer.set_bus_send(this_bus, "SFX") print("Updating Sound Parent ", name) for name in sub_music: var this_bus = AudioServer.get_bus_index(name) AudioServer.set_bus_send(this_bus, "MUSIC") print("Updating Music Parent ", name) func create_bus(name): if AudioServer.get_bus_index(name) == -1: AudioServer.add_bus(-1) AudioServer.set_bus_name(AudioServer.bus_count - 1, name) ``` ### Steps to reproduce Run the Addon from the Project->Tools script. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [test-project-plugin-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27263211/test-project-plugin-bug.zip)
